title: Session handoff / context transfer
body:
Export the full context of this session into a single self-contained block I can paste into a fresh chat to continue seamlessly. Include, verbatim where it matters:
- Current objective
- The narrative of what we've done
- Decisions made (with rationale)
- All artifacts in full
- Open questions
- Immediate next steps

Write it so a model with zero prior context can pick up exactly where we left off.

title: Summarize this conversation
body:
Summarize our conversation so far into a concise brief. Include:
1. The objective
2. Key decisions and their rationale
3. Any code/artifacts produced (reference by name)
4. Open questions
5. Concrete next steps

Use tight bullet points. Omit small talk.

title: Generate documentation
body:
You are a senior technical writer. Given the code/context below, produce clear documentation covering: purpose, prerequisites, setup/usage with examples, configuration options, and common pitfalls. Prefer prose with short code blocks. Do not invent behavior that isn't present in the source.

---
<paste code/context here>

title: Update all repos (bash)
body:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Pull latest on every git repo under the current directory
find . -maxdepth 2 -type d -name .git | while read -r gitdir; do
  repo="$(dirname "$gitdir")"
  echo "== $repo =="
  git -C "$repo" pull --ff-only
done

title: Update all repos (PowerShell)
Discard all local changes
body:
# Throw away uncommitted changes and untracked files (irreversible)
git reset --hard HEAD
git clean -fd
